description: Mechanistic causal chain for MSH3-related attenuated FAP, from biallelic germline loss to adenoma and carcinoma
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import FancyBboxPatch, FancyArrowPatch
import matplotlib as mpl

steps = [
 ("1. Biallelic germline MSH3 LoF\n(frameshift / splice / nonsense)", "#4C72B0"),
 ("2. No functional MSH3 protein;\nMutSβ (MSH2-MSH3) cannot form\nGO:0032302 lost", "#4C72B0"),
 ("3. Insertion-deletion loops of 2-13 nt\ngo unrecognised (GO:0032135/0032139)\nMutSα (MSH2-MSH6) stays intact", "#55A868"),
 ("4. Polymerase slippage at di- and\ntetranucleotide repeats is unrepaired\n→ EMAST in normal mucosa and tumour", "#55A868"),
 ("5. Frameshift indels hit repeat tracts\nin APC (12/13 were 2-5 bp deletions)\nand in ACVR2A, ARID genes", "#DD8452"),
 ("6. Biallelic APC inactivation stabilises\nβ-catenin → Wnt target transcription\nin colonic crypt stem cells (CL:0009043)", "#DD8452"),
 ("7. Clonal expansion → tubular adenomas,\nright-colon predominant, 18-54 cumulative\n(HP:0005227), fifth decade", "#C44E52"),
 ("8. Dysplasia gradient → colorectal\nadenocarcinoma (HP:0003003) in a\nsubset; duodenal adenomas in ~27%", "#C44E52"),
]
branches = [
 ("Branch A (demonstrated in vitro):\nMutSβ loss impairs homology-directed\nrepair of DSBs with secondary structures\nat common fragile sites → extra DSB burden", "#937860"),
 ("Branch B (inferred for this disease):\nimpaired HR plausibly underlies the\nbreast and other extracolonic lesions,\nbut n=5 women, not demonstrated", "#8C8C8C"),
]

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(13.5, 10.5))
ax.set_xlim(0, 10); ax.set_ylim(0, 10.6); ax.axis("off")
y = 9.9
for i,(txt,c) in enumerate(steps):
    h = 0.95
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((0.4, y-h), 5.4, h, boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                 facecolor=c, alpha=0.16, edgecolor=c, linewidth=1.6))
    ax.text(3.1, y-h/2, txt, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=9.3)
    if i < len(steps)-1:
        ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((3.1, y-h), (3.1, y-h-0.26),
                     arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=16, color="#555555", linewidth=1.4))
    y -= h + 0.26

# branches off step 2/3
by = 8.0
for txt,c in branches:
    ax.add_patch(FancyBboxPatch((6.3, by-1.35), 3.45, 1.35, boxstyle="round,pad=0.08",
                 facecolor=c, alpha=0.14, edgecolor=c, linewidth=1.4, linestyle="--"))
    ax.text(8.02, by-0.675, txt, ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.6)
    ax.add_patch(FancyArrowPatch((5.8, by-0.675+0.9), (6.3, by-0.675),
                 arrowstyle="-|>", mutation_scale=14, color="#777777", linewidth=1.2, linestyle="--"))
    by -= 2.0

ax.text(5.0, 10.35, "MSH3-related attenuated FAP (MONDO:0044300): causal chain from germline lesion to adenoma",
        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=12.5, fontweight="bold")
ax.text(8.02, 3.1, "Colours: blue = germline lesion,\ngreen = repair defect, orange = driver\nmutation and signalling, red = clinical\nphenotype. Dashed = branch.",
        ha="center", va="center", fontsize=8.5, color="#444444")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
